alloy.preparation: Prepared in a vacuum furnace; specimens cut from rolled sheet (5-mm thickness, 12-mm diameter). Solution-treated under nitrogen at 1150°C for 30 min, water-quenched; wet emery-polished through grade 1000, degreased in absolute ethanol, washed with deionized water and warm-air dried.

test_solution.preparation: NaCl chloride solution; no tungstate addition.

test_method.procedure_description: Tacussel potentiostat, current recorder and high-impedance electronic millivoltmeter; potentials on the SCE scale. Tungstate-concentration series at 60°C in 0.1 M NaCl. Separate −50 mV/15-min ESCA passivation is not assigned as pretreatment to these pitting curves.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Breakdown/pitting potential from the anodic-polarization transition, explicitly tabulated in the text as the concentration/composition sequence.

experiments.result_note: Printed breakdown potential in the tungstate concentration sequence. Continuous curves are not traced to generate extra values.
